current_difficulty_reason: The cited Popescu and prior relative-purity results do not directly establish the smoothable absolute-purity map over regular bases of mixed characteristic. The author proves the characteristic-zero reduction and develops the required exceptional-pullback extension and joint conservativity through continuity and essentially finite-presentation approximations. The complete first equal-characteristic purity argument then closes the reduction, rather than assuming absolute purity as a general six-operation identity.
